What We Deliver

End-to-End Email Marketing

Strategy, design, automation, and optimization — everything your email channel needs to become a revenue engine.

Marketing Automation

Welcome sequences, abandoned cart flows, re-engagement campaigns, and post-purchase series that run 24/7 and nurture leads on autopilot.

List Segmentation

Behavioral, demographic, and purchase-based segmentation that ensures every subscriber gets messages relevant to their specific needs and stage.

A/B Testing & Optimization

Subject lines, send times, content layouts, CTAs, and personalization variables tested systematically to continuously improve performance.

Email Design & Copywriting

Mobile-responsive templates and conversion-focused copy that reflects your brand voice and drives clicks — no generic templates.

List Growth & Management

Lead magnet strategy, opt-in form optimization, list hygiene, and compliance management that builds a healthy, engaged subscriber base.

Analytics & Revenue Attribution

Track opens, clicks, conversions, and revenue per email. See exactly how much your email program contributes to the bottom line.

Our Process

Building Your Email Revenue Engine

A structured approach that transforms email from a cost center into your most profitable marketing channel.

01

Email Program Audit

We review your current list health, deliverability, automation flows, past campaign performance, and tech stack to identify quick wins.

02

Strategy & Segmentation

We build a comprehensive email strategy with audience segments, campaign calendar, automation roadmap, and KPI targets.

03

Design & Build

Custom email templates designed for your brand, automation flows built in your ESP, and all tracking/tagging configured for attribution.

04

Launch & Test

Campaigns and automations go live with A/B tests on every critical element. We monitor deliverability and engagement daily.

05

Optimize & Scale

Monthly performance reviews drive ongoing improvements to copy, design, timing, and segmentation. We scale what works and sunset what doesn't.
